title: Experiment
description: One line of a recipe's experiment log, <pattern>.experiments.jsonl beside the recipe (autoresearch design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/AUTORESEARCH_RECORDS_2026-11-06.md, "Keep and discard through the router"). An experiment line is one write of the recipe, scored inside the write: keep (it becomes the tip as a held draft), discard (refused with this verdict) or fail (lint, a throw, a timeout or invalid output; logged and not counted against the budget). A holdout line is one holdout check a person's accept ran: one pass or fail bit. The log is append-only and hash-chained like provenance, written by the evaluator only, so an agent cannot supply a score. The dev evaluations and holdout checks spent under a plan are counted from it. Nothing writes it yet: scoring and the router hook are build plan items 5 and 6.

kind.description: experiment: one write of the recipe, scored. holdout: one holdout check, run when a person accepts the tip

plan.description: The sha of the eval plan in force

candidate.description: sha256 of the candidate recipe's source, which the blob store keeps under that hash (packages/naive/src/core/blobs.mjs). On a holdout line, the tip that was checked

base.description: The tip the candidate was edited from, or null for a recipe's first write. A write whose base is not the tip is refused before it is scored and logs no line

verdict.description: keep: beats the tip on dev by the margin, or is strictly smaller and no worse; it becomes the tip as a held draft. discard: refused with this verdict. fail: lint, a throw, a timeout or invalid output on training or dev; not counted against the budget

kept_as.description: On a keep: better (gain above the margin) or smaller (a strictly smaller source that is no worse)

dev.description: The one aggregate dev gives per experiment, scored against the tip on paired rows

score.description: The candidate's settled loss on dev; lower is better

stderr.description: The standard error of the paired difference, from the block bootstrap seeded by the plan's sha

tip_score.description: The tip's settled loss on the same rows, or null for a recipe's first write

margin.description: The gain a keep needed: the larger of min_gain and twice stderr

training.description: The training run's settled loss. Its per-row losses are shown by naive recipes check, never logged here

result.description: On a holdout line, the one bit the check answers

over_holdout.description: On a holdout line, true when the person accepted over a failed check (mentura accept --over-holdout, not built)

reason.description: Why, in words. Required on a fail: which lint rule, throw, timeout or output check

actor.description: Who wrote the candidate (a person or an agent), or on a holdout line the person who accepted

span.description: The judgment span of the evaluation in the venture's traces (EE-121), which the draft's provenance line names too

provenance.description: On a keep, the hash of the held draft's provenance line

agent.description: Who acted, shaped as a provenance line's agent (provenance-entry.schema.json)

kind.description: unverified: a door with no sign-in said a person acted; the id is a claimed name

id.description: A person's name or handle, or an agent's role id from the team plan

account.description: The account a door with sign-in checked for this person

session.description: A link or id for the session that acted

harness.description: The agent harness, such as Claude Code or Cursor, as it named itself

via.description: The interface the write came through

span.description: The trace span the write was made inside (traces/<session>.jsonl), so what changed points to the agent step that changed it

session.description: The trace file's session, when it differs from the trace id

prev.description: The previous line's hash, or genesis for the first line

hash.description: sha256 of prev followed by this line without its hash field, as JSON with sorted keys
